name: Fyodor Rostislavich
note: co-ruler of Anastasia and then contested ruler against Michael (Michael Theodorovich listed c. 1280s - c. 1290)

name: Aleksandr Fyodorovich Bryukhaty
note: de facto to 1463, de jure to 1471; last grand prince, forced to sign away the succession to Ivan III; principality incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Moscow
